provider: netcup Storage Space / Local Block Storage
category: NFS storage attached to a netcup server

free_tier.stated: Tariff A 250 GB / B 500 GB / C 1 TB inclusive, expandable per GB

egress.terms: Metered with a hard cliff: 'Depending on the plan you choose, you will have a certain amount of monthly traffic available … As soon as the traffic volume is exceeded, the associated Storage Space will be frozen until the end of the calendar month. Currently, we do not provide traffic statistics. It is therefore your responsibility to log your traffic usage yourself.' 2.5 / 5 / 10 TB included by tariff.

interface_detail: NFS, bound to a netcup server's IP (not a standalone product)
tooling: mount -t nfs; rclone can front it
chaining: NFS target behind a netcup VPS
limits_note: Requires an existing netcup vServer/root server. No traffic statistics — you must self-meter or you get frozen mid-month. Upgrades impossible in place (different hardware): you must book a new Storage Space and NFS-copy across.
reliability_note: NetApp-backed and redundant, which is why the €/GB is high.

evidence.proved: Tariff A €6.08/mo (250 GB incl., €0.037/GB extra, 2.5 TB traffic); B €9.72/mo (500 GB incl., €0.030/GB, 5 TB); C €18.23/mo (1 TB incl., €0.024/GB, 10 TB); 'Starts from €0.024 /GB in tariff C'
traffic freeze clause quoted verbatim; 'it is not possible to upgrade your existing Storage Space'
'The price is € 0.012 plus VAT per GB', max 8 TB

price_per_tb_month: Tariff C: €18.23 for the first 1 TB (€18.23/TB), then €0.024/GB = €24.58/TB for extra capacity — the marginal TB is MORE expensive than the first, and the traffic cap freezes the volume. Local Block Storage is €12.29/TB. Both are 6–12× Hetzner.
notes: Tariff A 250 GB / B 500 GB / C 1 TB inclusive, expandable per GB
